headline:
لعبة Solo Leveling
تصدر على الأجهزة المنزلية
label: رسمي
note: Official X post @SLA_OVERDRIVE (verified) 28 Oct 17:01Z: PS5 and Xbox on 11/4 00:00 UTC (04:00 UAE, 4 Nov). Gematsu: Netmarble and Netmarble Neo announced; Xbox Series. Steam app 2373990: PC out 24 Nov 2025, 159 AED; short description: the Solo Leveling webtoon, Sung Jinwoo, world's strongest hunter, four-player co-op raids. Footage: Netmarble's launch trailer and Gameplay Highlights trailer (Steam 1080p60, 5.9 Mbps, decode clean); ESRB icon at the left edge of the opening shots falls outside the 9:16 window. Sound: one stretch of the Gameplay Highlights trailer's music from 47.0 s; its last spoken word ends 46.22 s and nothing is spoken after it (speechcheck), so no speech under the Reel. The launch trailer has dialogue throughout, so its pictures run under this music. v2: v1 stopped on the smear check at 3.13-3.57 s, the suit shot fading to black (16.3 s) cut hard into the bright street; the street shot also carried the game's English NOTICE / LEVEL UP box across the frame. The suit shot now ends at 16.2 s and the street is replaced by Jinwoo facing the red demon (gameplay 4.0 s); line 3 shows the co-op raid (gameplay 62.6 and 64.4 s, several players on a boss) and reads «مع غارات تعاونية / لأربعة لاعبين» (DeepL read the bare «وغارات لأربعة لاعبين» as 'four players were sent off'). v3: v2's opening face shot put Jinwoo's face under the headline band (the grid tile showed his chest); v3 opens on the glowing-eyed Jinwoo in his suit (face below the band, as v2 showed at 2.0 s), then the armoured red knight (gameplay 39.8 s).
